title: Global tensor pullback mates are isomorphisms
statement: For a scheme X and an adjunction P ⊣ Γ(X,-), the mate of the global-sections unit map and the mates of the section tensor maps under the adjunction are isomorphisms.

proof.text: Identify the adjunction with inverse image from the global-sections point and compute the unit and tensor mates on local pure tensors; the explicit maps have inverses given by inserting 1 and multiplying coefficients, so they are isomorphisms. Transport along the unique isomorphism of left adjoints to obtain the assertion for P.

lean.statement:
theorem globalTensorPullback_mates_isIso
    (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) :
    IsIso ((adj.homEquiv (𝟙_ _) (𝟙_ _)).symm
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (unitSectionsEquiv (X := X) ⊤).toLinearMap)) ∧
    ∀ A B : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)),
      IsIso ((adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((adj.unit.app A ⊗ₘ adj.unit.app B) ≫
          moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X (P.obj A) (P.obj B)))
